name: What to Wear
description: Looks at the forecast for the morning, afternoon and evening and tells you what to wear, adjusted to whether you feel the cold.
prompt: A what to wear app using the free Open-Meteo forecast API with no key, with my location or a searched city. Look at today's temperature, feels like, rain chance, wind and UV for the morning, afternoon and evening and suggest an outfit with big emoji cards like coat, sweater, t-shirt, umbrella, sunglasses and scarf. Let me say if I feel the cold more or less than most people and adjust the advice. Also suggest what to wear tomorrow.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Mira la previsión de mañana, tarde y noche y te dice qué ponerte, según lo friolero que seas.
